sources.publisher: XRP Insights — exchange-balance methodology and XRP Radar
claims: The detailed page reports 22.48B XRP in 701 wallets across 24 exchanges at 08:00 UTC October 31; same-wallet change is -133.0M over seven days and -12.3M over 30 days.
Binance attributed wallets total 2.78B XRP with +17.6M over seven days and +30.3M over 30 days; Coinbase 5.85B with +17.7M and +18.4M; SBI VC Trade 59.5M with -899K and -10.5M.
The daily table reports +105.9M aggregate same-wallet movement on October 31.
The overview page displays Binance +196.2M and Coinbase +13.3M among per-exchange deltas without an explicit interval label.
Summing the rounded per-exchange overview deltas gives approximately +106.58M, within 0.68M of the detailed page's +105.9M daily aggregate.
limitations: The +196.2M Binance interval is not explicitly labeled on the overview page; interpreting it as a daily same-wallet delta is an inference supported by the aggregate reconciliation.
The overview deltas are rounded; the 0.68M difference is not an exact reconciliation.
No per-wallet history is published, so the daily change cannot be attributed to particular source wallets or transactions.
The 22.48B broad attributed-wallet total includes cold/omnibus custody and approximately 487.2M XRP of non-customer reserves/funds; it is not tradable float.

findings: The broad Binance attributed-wallet series is positive over both seven and 30 days, disconfirming a simplistic persistent-decline narrative.
The overview's +196.2M Binance delta is likely daily but remains unconfirmed pending the downloadable machine-readable dataset.
limitations: Exchange balances are broad custody inventory, not customer-owned tradable float.
The same provider supplies both the escrow and exchange-balance views; they are not independent sources.
Daily per-exchange overview intervals are not explicitly labeled.
